idea: Risk-neutralized version of the call-minus-put implied volatility spread (Cremers-Weinbaum 2010): informed option demand predicts returns; neutralizing common style factors keeps only the stock-specific part of the signal.
rationale_data: atm_call_option_implied_volatility and atm_put_option_implied_volatility: at-the-money implied volatilities; market_capitalization_value_2: company size used to weight liquid names.
rationale_operators: rank() makes the spread a uniform cross-sectional score, centred by subtracting 0.5 and scaled by rank of size so liquid names carry more weight.

idea: Risk-neutralized combination of two chart-image CNN return forecasts (Jiang, Kelly and Xiu 2023): averaging two views of the price image adds breadth; risk neutralization removes momentum and reversal exposure the image model shares with style factors.
rationale_data: img30d_return_bisection_prob1_zackbatch and img30d_return_quintile: CNN forecasts of the next 30-day return from price chart images.
rationale_operators: rank() puts both forecasts on the same uniform scale before adding them.

idea: Slow-factor-neutralized analyst-based 60-day return forecast, smoothed over a month: keeps the forecast's stock-specific part and removes value, size and quality exposure.
rationale_data: analyst_60d_regression_pred: model forecast of the 60-day return built from analyst data.
rationale_operators: ts_mean() averages the forecast over 21 days to cut turnover; rank() makes it a uniform cross-sectional score.

idea: Slow-factor-neutralized price-target revision: the bias-free price target relative to its own last quarter (Brav and Lehavy 2003), with style exposure removed.
rationale_data: avg_first_biasfree_price_target_estimate: average analyst price target adjusted for known analyst biases.
rationale_operators: ts_zscore() compares the target with its own 63-day history; rank() makes it a cross-sectional score.
